steps.caption: The Landlord offers card already holds one offer: Riverside Towers.
Record a second offer, from the Kharadi Tech Park LOI.
Type the terms as the landlord wrote them. Leave blank anything it does not say.
Now both offers sit side by side, one line per term.
Bold marks the better offer on each line; blanks show as 'unknown', never zero.
Costs use the same start date and a 10% discount rate, from tested lease formulas — not AI.
Save comparison as an analysis keeps it in the Deal toolkit, with your own discount rate and start date.
Revise saves a landlord's updated terms as a new version; the old version is kept.
